title: The Ghost of Kowloon
author: Dominic Pemberton
blurb: Dominic Whitlock, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
